Message.Name: TradeCaptureReport
Message.Description: An XT is submitted in a single Trade Capture Report message (MsgType 35 = AE), with the Member acting on behalf of both the buyer and the seller.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if ISIN is used to identify the security, IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). ZAC = South African Cents

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: 4 = ISIN, 5 = RIC. Please refer to the Note on Symbology in the A2X FIX 4.2 Specification

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of the trade. Validated against the elected BBO (see Section 2).

Field.Name: LastQty
Field.Description: Quantity of the trade. No minimum size applies to XT trades.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: If using alternative symbology, RIC (primary or A2X) or ISIN depending on the value of IDSource (22)

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Uniform symbology code for the security (not required if alternative symbology is used)

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the transaction represented by this TCR occurred (expressed in UTC)

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Date of trade in YYYYMMDD format. Current day only.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Required if ISIN is used, IDSource (22) = 4. XJSE = JSE (Johannesburg)

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for the Trade Capture Report

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: Cross Trade values: 11 = Cross trade, price check against PBBO, 12 = Cross trade, price check against APBBO

Field.Name: TrdSubType
Field.Description: 6 = Cross trade for clearing. TrdSubType (829) must be 6; clearing is not a per-trade choice on an XT. Self-trade suppression for clearing at the session level takes precedence. See the Clearing Configuration section of the A2X FIX 4.2 Specification.

Field.Name: OrderAttributeTypes
Field.Description: 4 = Algorithmic trade (transaction executed as a result of algorithmic trading as defined in Article 4(1)(39) of Directive 2014/65/EU). Default if not supplied = No.

Message.Name: TradeCaptureReportAck
Message.Description: In response to a submitted XT, A2X sends a Trade Capture Report Acknowledgement (MsgType 35 = AR) echoing the submitted fields, as set out in the A2X FIX 4.2 Specification Section 5.7.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique ID for the trading day for this Trade Capture Report. Corresponds to the TVTIC for transaction reporting purposes.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: TCR status: F = Trade (price within the elected BBO), 8 = Rejected (price outside the elected BBO)

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Reason text in the case of a reject

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming Trade Capture Report

Field.Name: TrdSubType
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming Trade Capture Report

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for each chain of orders. Value must be greater than 1.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: House or Client Account for use with clearing. If not supplied, A2X will assume ‘House’. Values need to be pre-loaded on the trading platform.

Field.Name: SideOrderCapacity
Field.Description: The capacity for this side of the trade: A = Agency, P = Principal

Value.Description: Cross trade, price check against PBBO
Cross trade, price check against APBBO
Algorithmic trade (transaction executed as a result of algorithmic trading as defined in Article 4(1)(39) of Directive 2014/65/EU)
